searchText: Trinity is making a lot of progress on the client-side. It's looking super promising for getting and keeping up with the head of the chain. There's more to do to make it work better in adverse conditions, but it's already a huge win over a non-witness Beam Sync. What are your thoughts on adding client-side witness collection to Beam Sync in Nethermind <@!489256758989029405> ? I want to do that a lot just temporarily cannot pick it up but I think we can add it relatively quickly just want to harden some bits ahead of eth2 gotcha, yeah, so many important things to work on at the same time 👍
